import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    private static final long P = 1000000007L;
    
    static class FiniteField {
        private long x;
        
        public FiniteField() { this.x = 0; }
        public FiniteField(long x) {
            this.x = x % P;
            if (this.x < 0) this.x += P;
        }
        public long getValue() { return x; }
        
        public FiniteField plus(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x + o.x) % P);
        }
        public FiniteField minus(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x - o.x + P) % P);
        }
        public FiniteField times(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x * o.x) % P);
        }
        public FiniteField divide(FiniteField o) {
            long exp = P - 2;
            long base = o.x;
            long res = 1;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % P;
                base = (base * base) % P;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return new FiniteField((x * res) % P);
        }
        
        public void add(FiniteField o) { x = (x + o.x) % P; }
        public void subtract(FiniteField o) { x = (x - o.x + P) % P; }
        public void multiply(FiniteField o) { x = (x * o.x) % P; }
        public void divide(FiniteField o) {

            long base = o.x;
            long res = 1;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % P;
                base = (base * base) % P;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            x = (x * res) % P;
        }
    }
    
    private static List<List<FiniteField>> make2D(int d1, int d2, long val) {
        List<List<FiniteField>> res = new ArrayList<>(d1);
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            List<FiniteField> row = new ArrayList<>(d2);
            for (int j = 0; j < d2; j++) {
                row.add(new FiniteField(val));
            }
            res.add(row);
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    private static List<List<List<FiniteField>>> make3D(int d1, int d2, int d3, long val) {
        List<List<List<FiniteField>>> res = new ArrayList<>(d1);
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            List<List<FiniteField>> mat = make2D(d2, d3, val);
            res.add(mat);
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    private static List<List<FiniteField>> multiply(List<List<FiniteField>> a, List<List<FiniteField>> b) {
        int n = a.size();
        int m = a.get(0).size();
        if (b.size() != m) throw new RuntimeException("Matrix dimensions don't match for multiplication!");
        int l = b.get(0).size();
        List<List<FiniteField>> result = make2D(n, l, 0L);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < l; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    FiniteField product = a.get(i).get(k).times(b.get(k).get(j));
                    result.get(i).set(j, result.get(i).get(j).plus(product));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    private static List<FiniteField> multiplyMatVec(List<List<FiniteField>> mat, List<FiniteField> vec) {
        int n = mat.size();
        int m = mat.get(0).size();
        if (vec.size() != m) throw new RuntimeException("Matrix and vector dimensions don't match!");
        List<FiniteField> result = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            FiniteField sum = new FiniteField(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                sum = sum.plus(mat.get(i).get(j).times(vec.get(j)));
            }
            result.add(sum);
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    // Shared data for findMatrix
    private static int d;
    private static List<List<List<FiniteField>>> shifts;
    private static List<List<List<FiniteField>>> units;
    private static List<List<FiniteField>> identity;
    private static HashMap<Long, List<List<FiniteField>>> cache;
    
    private static List<List<FiniteField>> findMatrix(long p) {
        if (cache.containsKey(p)) {
            return cache.get(p);
        }
        if (p <= d) {
            List<List<FiniteField>> matrix = identity;
            for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                matrix = multiply(units.get(k), matrix);
            }
            return matrix;
        }
        long child_p = d;
        while ((p + child_p - 1) / child_p > d) {
            child_p *= d;
        }
        List<List<FiniteField>> child = findMatrix(child_p);
        List<List<FiniteField>> matrix = child;
        long remaining_p = p - child_p;
        for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
            if (remaining_p >= child_p) {
                List<List<FiniteField>> temp = multiply(shifts.get(k), matrix);
                temp = multiply(child, temp);
                matrix = multiply(shifts.get(d - k), temp);
                remaining_p -= child_p;
            } else if (remaining_p > 0) {
                List<List<FiniteField>> temp = multiply(shifts.get(k), matrix);
                temp = multiply(findMatrix(remaining_p), temp);
                matrix = multiply(shifts.get(d - k), temp);
                remaining_p = 0;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        cache.put(p, matrix);
        return matrix;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        d = sc.nextInt();
        
        shifts = make3D(d, d + 1, d + 1, 0L);
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                shifts.get(k).get(i).set((i + k) % d, new FiniteField(1));
            }
            shifts.get(k).get(d).set(d, new FiniteField(1));
        }
        
        units = make3D(d, d + 1, d + 1, 0L);
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(i).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(k).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
            }
        }
        
        identity = make2D(d + 1, d + 1, 0L);
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
            identity.get(i).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
        }
        
        cache = new HashMap<>();
        
        List<List<FiniteField>> matrix = findMatrix(n);
        
        List<FiniteField> baseVector = new ArrayList<>(d + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; i++) {
            baseVector.add(new FiniteField(0));
        }
        baseVector.set(d, new FiniteField(1));
        
        List<FiniteField> finalVector = multiplyMatVec(matrix, baseVector);
        FiniteField ans = new FiniteField(0);
        for (FiniteField ff : finalVector) {
            ans = ans.plus(ff);
        }
        System.out.println(ans.getValue());
    }
}
